summary: Every factual claim in the short report matches the checks, crawl, snapshot, screenshots and transcript (43/43 checks pass, styled pages and media-library images confirmed in the screenshots), and its one gap — never mentioning the grader's quality issues such as the thin posts and the missing post metadata — is not breakage it was obliged to report.

claims.evidence: codex-stream.jsonl: one early HttpClient check failed and curl got a 404 at one point. Later curl checks (lines 4063-4074) returned STATUS:200 for the front page and posts. check.json: site.allPagesRender shows 3 pages OK.

claims.claim: Front page at https://localhost:44317/ with posts at /mcp-makes-content-operations-conversational/ and /mcp-turns-umbraco-into-a-creative-teammate/
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: all three paths return 200, and the front page links both posts (2/2).

claims.claim: Page, Repository Item, Block, and Data document types
claims.evidence: grade.md: blogFrontPage is in Pages, blogPost in Repository Items, the hero/richText/listing blocks in Blocks, blockSettings in Data. The grader marks blogPost being in Repository Items as a minor modeling issue, but the report states its location accurately.

claims.claim: Block Grid data type with hero, rich-text, and listing blocks
claims.evidence: grade.md: 'Blog Block Grid' has 3 blocks (heroBlock, richTextBlock, blogListingBlock). check.json: schema.blockGridOnPages covers blogFrontPage and blogPost.
check.json: content.twoBlogPosts lists both titles and content.allPublished passes. The posts are short (grader: major issue), but the report makes no claim about their length.
check.json: content.hasMedia = 3, mediaFromProvidedPhotos = 3/3, 0 hot-linked images. grade.md: 3 photos in a Blog Images folder.

claims.claim: `/` domain assigned to the front page

claims.evidence: check.json changes: uSync/v18 ContentTypes, DataTypes, Content, Media and Domains config files were added.

claims.claim: Rendering uses the required block-grid pipeline, adapters, ViewComponents, and Razor views
claims.evidence: check.json: code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper, adapterPerBlock (3), adaptersInvokeViewComponents (3/3), viewComponentPerBlock (3) and adaptersHaveNoMarkup all pass.

claims.claim: `dotnet build` and frontend `npm run build` both pass cleanly
claims.evidence: check.json build: 0 errors, 0 warnings. codex-stream.jsonl line 3618: vite build exited 0. check.json: code.frontendBuilt passes.
check.json: site.boots passes. The model's last curl checks returned 200s.
